name: Merrin Rockweaver
summary: Merrin Rockweaver is a dwarven researcher representing the Explorers' League in the Wetlands. Following a violent raptor infestation that overran Whelgar's Excavation Site, she took refuge alongside Prospector Whelgar on a ridge overlooking the site.

sections.title: Displaced by the Dig
sections.body: Merrin Rockweaver traveled to the Wetlands on behalf of the Ironforge Explorers' League to unearth ancient Titan secrets buried beneath the muck. The expedition ended in disaster when the large bones they unearthed drew raptors to the dig. Vicious prehistoric beasts swarmed the trenches, forcing Merrin and the surviving crew to abandon their equipment, notes, and progress. She is now trapped with the few survivors on a bluff overlooking the overrun ruins.

sections.title: Salvaging the Operation
sections.body: Trapped on the bluff, the survivors refuse to let the expedition become an outright failure. While Ormer Ironbraid plots vengeance against the beasts and Prospector Whelgar seeks the tablet fragments left behind in the raptor-infested trenches, Merrin's thoughts turn to her husband Tarrel, who has not heard from her in weeks. She relies on the scout Longbraid sent to find the team to carry word of their plight back to him.

faq.answer: Merrin Rockweaver is a dwarf archaeologist affiliated with the Explorers' League of Ironforge. She was stationed at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands before raptors overran the operation.

faq.q: Why is she trapped above the dig site?
aliases: why is merrin at the retreat
faq.answer: Mottled raptors, drawn by the large bones the team uncovered, overwhelmed the dig site below and many lives were lost. Ormer Ironbraid defended Merrin and Prospector Whelgar as they fled to the nearby bluff, where they remain trapped.

faq.q: What does Merrin need help with?
faq.answer: Merrin needs someone to carry a letter explaining the disaster back to her husband Tarrel, who has been worried sick since her letters stopped arriving.

faq.q: What was the expedition trying to find?
faq.answer: Like most Explorers' League operations, the Wetlands dig was commissioned to uncover ancient artifacts related to dwarven ancestry and the mysterious Titan relics hidden throughout Khaz Modan.

angles.text: For dwarven adventurers, aiding Merrin is a matter of national heritage, safeguarding the precious Titan relics and historical records that the Explorers' League risked their lives to uncover.
Merrin represents Ironforge's academic presence in the Wetlands, and securing her research helps maintain the Alliance's tenuous foothold in the wild marshland.
